shortDescription: Allergan operates in the UAE under Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, delivering medical aesthetics and specialty pharmaceuticals.
whatTheyDo: The company provides medical aesthetics products, including facial injectables, plastics, and body contouring treatments such as Botox and Juvéderm. In the UAE, regional operations handle commercial distribution, medical education, and regulatory affairs across the Middle East.
address: Unit 802, Level 8, Index Tower, Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Index Tower DIFC Commercial Directory - Allergan
U.S. SEC Filing - Allergan Middle East Subsidiaries

notes: Listed in directory as JLT, but Allergan's corporate office in Dubai is in Index Tower at DIFC. Allergan was acquired by AbbVie in 2020 and operates primarily through Allergan Aesthetics.

shortDescription: Allianz Trade provides trade credit insurance, surety bonding, and credit risk management in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Operating through Allianz Trade Middle East Limited (ATME Ltd.), a DFSA-regulated insurance manager based in the DIFC, the company offers trade credit insurance, business fraud coverage, and debt collection services. It partners with local fronting insurers to protect commercial enterprises across the GCC against default and insolvency risks.
address: Office 701-702, Tower 1, DIFC Square, Al Mustaqbal Street, Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Emirates News Agency (WAM) - Allianz Trade Expands Regional Presence at DIFC Square
Dubai International Financial Centre - Allianz Trade Middle East Expansion

notes: Listed in directory as Dubai Internet City, but the regional corporate headquarters is in DIFC Square at the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC).

shortDescription: Mohamed & Obaid Al Mulla Group is a long-standing family conglomerate based in Dubai operating across healthcare, hospitality, and real estate.
whatTheyDo: Established in 1942, the group's flagship operations include the American Hospital Dubai healthcare network, Ishraq Hospitality (managing international hotel franchises), and extensive commercial and residential real estate holdings across Dubai.
address: Al Mulla Building, Baniyas Road, Deira, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Gulf News - Mohamed & Obaid Al Mulla Group Profile
Forbes Middle East - Top 100 Arab Family Businesses: Mohamed & Obaid Al Mulla Group

notes: Listed in directory as Downtown Dubai, but no Almulla Group entity is based in Downtown. The primary Dubai family conglomerate is Mohamed & Obaid Al Mulla Group located in Deira. Several distinct regional entities share the 'Al Mulla' name (such as Almulla Capital on Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Mulla Group in Fujairah, and Al Mulla Group in Kuwait).

shortDescription: Alpha Data is a leading UAE digital transformation and IT systems integration company.
whatTheyDo: Founded in 1981 and listed on the ADX, Alpha Data provides end-to-end technology solutions covering cybersecurity, enterprise cloud, artificial intelligence, IoT, and managed services. It works with global technology partners to serve enterprise, healthcare, and government clients from its offices in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
address: Level 26, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE

sources.title: Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) - Alpha Data Profile
IBM Partner Directory - Alpha Data Abu Dhabi

notes: Listed in directory with Dubai Healthcare City, but Alpha Data has no office in DHCC; its Dubai office is in Mazaya Business Avenue, JLT, while corporate headquarters is in Addax Tower, Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi.

shortDescription: Alrais Enterprises Group (ALRAIS Holding) is an Emirati multi-sector family enterprise based in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Founded in 1997 by Ali M. Alrais, the group started with the Arabian Tea House brand and expanded across hospitality, travel and destination management, retail and trade, facilities management, and real estate in Dubai.
address: Villa 600, Al Wasl Road, Jumeirah 3, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Naukrigulf Company Profile - Alrais Enterprises Group
HealthFinder Business Directory - Alrais Group Dubai

notes: Listed in directory as JLT, but corporate headquarters is at Villa 600 on Al Wasl Road, Jumeirah, Dubai. Not to be confused with Al Rais Travel & Shipping Agencies (Al Rais Group).

shortDescription: Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides cloud infrastructure, platforms, and technical consultancy in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: AWS established its Dubai Internet City presence in 2017 to provide enterprise solutions architecture, account management, partner enablement, and technical support across the Middle East. It operates cloud infrastructure data center clusters under the AWS Middle East (UAE) Region serving government and enterprise clients.
address: Dubai Properties Headquarters Building, Al Falak Street, Dubai Internet City, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Gulf News - Amazon Web Services opens office in Dubai
Dubai Eye 103.8 - AWS Establishes Hub in Dubai Internet City

notes: AWS corporate and commercial support offices are located on Al Falak Street in Dubai Internet City; physical data center locations are confidential for security reasons.

whatTheyDo: Founded in 2000 and publicly listed on the Dubai Financial Market, Amlak Finance offers Islamic residential and commercial financing solutions, investment property financing, and real estate asset management services for individuals and corporate clients across the UAE.
